project_type: Greenfield Node.js microservices with AWS CDK infrastructure
language: JavaScript (Node.js) for services, TypeScript for CDK infra
build_system: npm per service and infra directory; no build step needed for plain JS Lambda handlers
build_command: cd infra && npm run build (TypeScript CDK compile)
verification_instructions: Since network is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, verification is code review only - confirm all files are present, package.json dependencies are correct, Lambda handlers export a valid handler, CDK stack synthesizes conceptually.
setup_instructions: npm install in each of services/users, services/tasks, and infra (to be run by developer, not in sandbox)
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY - no npm install, no cdk deploy, no Docker, no AWS CLI calls. Write code only.
key_patterns: Lambda handler wraps Express app using aws-serverless-express or @vendia/serverless-express. DynamoDB access via AWS SDK v3 (@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb + @aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb). CDK uses aws-cdk-lib constructs. Each service is self-contained.
directory_structure: services/users/ - Users Express REST API as Lambda handler; services/tasks/ - Tasks Express REST API as Lambda handler; infra/ - AWS CDK TypeScript stack defining Lambda + API GW + DynamoDB for both services
